close_reason: fixed: MailboxRole always serializes as bare JSON string via impl_string_enum!; added comment documenting this invariant at both as_str() call sites
description: mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_set create loop checks role_just_created by inspecting values in the created map: v.get('role').and_then(|r| r.as_str()). The created map stores the full serialized Mailbox object returned by the backend. If the Mailbox role field serializes as a JSON object (e.g. {"type":"inbox"}) rather than a bare string, the as_str() call returns None and the uniqueness check silently passes, allowing two mailboxes to be created with the same role in a single request. This is an implicit coupling between the serialization format of MailboxRole and the correctness of the uniqueness guard.
title: Mailbox role-uniqueness check in create uses created map but role is full serialized object
